heading: Regulations
lead: The Assistant Secretary shall issue and periodically update regulations respecting—

tree.text: conflicts of interest by persons described in subparagraphs (A) and (B) of section 3058g(f)(1) of this title; and
the relationships described in clauses (i) through (vi) of section 3058g(f)(1)(C) of this title.

notes.text: Amendments2016—Par. (1). Pub. L. 114–144, § 8(d)(1), substituted “subparagraphs (A) and (B) of section 3058g(f)(1)” for “paragraphs (1) and (2) of section 3058g(f)”. Par. (2). Pub. L. 114–144, § 8(d)(2), substituted “clauses (i) through (vi) of section 3058g(f)(1)(C)” for “subparagraphs (A) through (D) of section 3058g(f)(3)”. 1993—Pub. L. 103–171 substituted “Assistant Secretary” for “Commissioner”.
